name: USPhoneBook
instructions: Look up your phone number on usphonebook.com. If you're listed, open usphonebook.com/opt-out and follow the steps, using {contact_email} where it asks for an email. If the opt-out page just hangs, email support+optout@usphonebook.com and ask to be removed. Then press "I've done this".
source: Process and the support+optout@usphonebook.com fallback per BADBOOL's USPhoneBook entry.
